lq.q: Explain the difference between reaction and response in human interaction.
answer: In human interaction, reaction means deciding our feeling and behaviour based on the other person’s behaviour. If the other behaves properly, we may behave properly; if the other misbehaves, we may also misbehave. In this case, our “remote control” is with the other person and our conduct becomes indefinite. Response means deciding our feeling on our own right, based on natural acceptance and right understanding. In response, the behaviour of the other is only an indicator of the other person’s state. With that input, we decide our behaviour to ensure mutual happiness. Response is self-organised, definite and unconditional, while reaction is dependent, indefinite and often leads to unhappiness.
